items.statement: Q3 FY25 total revenue INR 548 crores (+37% YoY); SLCM INR 470 crores (+37%); Non-SLCM INR 44 crores (+71.5%); Spares & Services INR 34 crores (+13.6%)
items.quote: Our total revenue in Q3 grew by 37% year-on-year and stood at INR 548 crores.

items.statement: Q3 FY25 EBITDA INR 88 crores (+31.8% YoY); PAT INR 68 crores (+26.3%); PAT margin 12.3% (-90 bps)
items.quote: For Q3 FY25, our EBITDA grew by 31.8% year-on-year and stood at INR 88 crores.

items.statement: No immediate acquisition plans for 3D printing; in-house design and engineering capabilities sufficient; will evaluate landscape if needed
items.quote: Currently, we have all the capabilities to be able to address the requirements that are coming up in this country and potentially outside the country. If and when we think there is a need to look at suitable technologies that will propel us, we will, as an organization, continue to examine and look at the landscape.

items.statement: Order backlog at INR 5,170 million with immediate pipeline of INR 7,000 million
items.quote: Our order backlog remained strong at INR 5,170 million, with an immediate order pipeline of INR 7,000 million.

items.statement: Sangli power products has INR 180 crores booked orders and INR 450 crores negotiated awaiting POs
items.quote: At this current moment in the Sangli business of power products, we have about INR 180 crores of order already booked giving more than a year's visibility and about INR 450 crores of order which have been almost negotiated and are awaiting POs at different points of time.

items.statement: Board approved investment in 10-acre facility at E5/E6 Sangli and capacity addition at Cochin plant
items.quote: In the recent board meeting, the board approved investment at a 10-acre facility that has already been acquired next to us at E5 and E6 in Sangli and also enhanced capacity addition in Cochin plant of ours.

items.statement: Board approved INR 125 crores soft loan from promoter family at repo plus 0.5% (~7%) with 15-year tenure and 2-year moratorium
items.quote: the board has also approved INR125 crores soft loan from the promoter family at a repo plus 0.5 that is approximately 7% with a 15 -year tenure that can be extended and a two -year moratorium that also can be extended offering a flexible penalty-free repayment.

items.statement: Q3 FY25 EBITDA margin at record 24%, management believes sustainable around 20% for short to medium term
items.quote: EBITDA for the quarter was INR 174 million, reflecting a 63.2% year -on-year increase, with margins expanding to a record 24%.

items.statement: Management expects blended EBITDA margin around 20% sustainable for short to medium term
items.quote: I would believe that we should be around 20%, sir. I believe it is sustainable for a short to medium term.

items.statement: Coil products currently ~50% of revenue, expected to become far higher than 50% going forward
items.quote: I believe the way things are going on; it will be at this moment around close to 50%. But I believe going ahead in the future, it will be far higher than 50%.

items.statement: Power solutions expected to be 20-25% of total business going forward from current 50-50 split
items.quote: However, the forward guidance would be the power solutions would be about 20% to 25% of the total business.

items.statement: Strong demand from power transmission and distribution sectors driving order inflow
items.quote: The strong orders inflow undertook sustained demand from the power transmission and distribution sectors.

items.statement: Indian revenue expected to increase in immediate quarters due to HVDC, STATCOM and renewable energy projects
items.quote: I believe for the immediate few quarters, the Indian revenue would increase. Also, a lot of manufacturing revenue would increase, which would also stabilize our quarter -on-quarter numbers.

items.statement: Margins could be disrupted by dollar fluctuation, metal price disruption or geopolitical risk
items.quote: I believe for the current moment, or I would say in the next one to three years, we do not see any drastic difference unless there is a dollar or a metal disruption across the industry or a geopolitical risk.

items.statement: Current facilities maxed out; new investments target 8x-9x current capacity to handle INR 800-900 crores order book
items.quote: We will not be in a position to handle about INR 800 crores or INR 900 crores of order book in the current facility. So, we will need a facility at least 3x to 4x of our capacity. We believe the new investments will go at least 8x to 9x for our current capacity.

items.statement: Acquired 51% of Mehru Electrical for ~INR 120 crores; planning majority stake in STATCON Energiaa (INR 170 crores revenue) within 45 days target
items.quote: Among the other developments post IPO, we have acquired 51% of Mehru Electrical and Mechanical Engineers in Bhiw adi that is in NCR, for about INR 120 crores.

items.statement: STATCON acquisition to be funded from IPO proceeds (INR 60 crores allocated for unidentified acquisition); primary only transaction
items.quote: The GCP, when we had, when we raised the money for the IPO, already allowed us close to 60 crores for another unidentified acquisition. We are using the money from the IPO and not from anywhere else.

items.statement: Mehru EBITDA margin improved from ~6% (INR 13 crores on INR 213 crores) to ~10% (INR 18 crores on INR 180 crores in 9 months) post-acquisition
items.quote: If you look at last year, their numbers were on a sale of about give and take INR 213 crores. They had done an EBITDA of about INR 13 plus crores. And in nine months, they have done almost INR 180 crores with an EBITDA of about INR 18 crores.

items.statement: Agreed with international investors to jointly invest up to 100 million USD over the next three to five years for equity requirements of PPP projects in municipal water sector
items.quote: Today we are pleased to announce that we have agreed with international investors to jointly invest up to 100 million USD over the next three to five years . This investment will support the equity requirements of Public-Private Partnership projects in the municipal water sector.

items.statement: Foresees a business opportunity of around a billion USD in PPP projects over three to five years
items.quote: We foresee a business opportunity of around a billion USD in PPP projects.

items.statement: Preferentially placed orders worth INR 2,000 to 2,500 crores are under evaluation; first order of INR 360 crores already received, rest expected in next few months
items.quote: We announced these preferentially placed positions in the last call. We are pursuing all of them. They are under evaluation. You've already seen the first set coming in. You'll see in the next few months, the rest of the orders will also reach its logical completion.

items.statement: Saudi Arabia re-tender for INR 2,700 crores order is ongoing; bid to be placed next month
items.quote: Correct. So, the tender is already out. We are working on the tender. We will be placing the bid in the next month.

items.statement: PPP platform will focus predominantly on India, with selective opportunities in Southeast Asia and Africa
items.quote: Predominantly, it will be India to start with. We will also be looking at Southeast Asia and maybe very selectively the African opportunities also we will look at.

items.statement: Margins on PPP projects will be consistent with existing DBO opportunities as Wabag remains asset-light focusing on EPC and O&M
items.quote: So, for us, this is like any other opportunity. We will evaluate this like any other DBO opportunity that we are doing. So, the margins will be consistent with that.

items.statement: No exposure to Jal Jeevan Mission which faces payment delays; Wabag is a technology system integrator not into civil works
items.quote: We are a technology system integrator. We are not into civil works. Jal Jeevan Mission is not our focus. That is all piping and civil works. We don't have any projects in Jal Jeevan Mission. So, we don't face any of this.

items.statement: Progressing as expected in line with medium term outlook; fourth quarter progressing well
items.quote: We are progressing as expected in line with our medium term outlook that we have already given. That remains and we are progressing well.

items.statement: Platform equity of 100 million USD can support 1 billion USD of project opportunities at roughly 1:10 equity to project ratio
items.quote: one-tenth in these projects. Skandaprasad S.: Correct. We will have a mix of HAM and BOOT, but broadly we see that one billion dollars worth of opportunities can be pursued with this platform in its current level

items.statement: EPC and O&M revenues from PPP projects will be 100% booked in Wabag's books; no revenue sharing with equity partners
items.quote: So there is no sharing of revenue. This is an SPV which is holding the concession, but the entire EPC and O&M is done by Wabag. So, the revenues of EPC and O&M will be 100% to Wabag.

items.statement: Additional 4-6 months typically required for financial closure and conditions precedent in PPP projects beyond normal EPC execution timelines
items.quote: Only thing about four to six months additional time will normally be given for financial closure and completion of all the conditions pre cedent. Nothing more than
